services.desc: Known as the "Willie", Prins Willem is one of the most popular ship wrecks in Milwaukee and Great Lakes history. She lies intact at about 80 feet with penetration possible for the trained and experienced divers. Dutch motor ship built in 1949 at Neder-Hardinxveld, Netherlands by N.V. Scheepswerf en Mahchinefabrik, "De Merwede" Voorheen Van Vliet & Co. for Oranje Line, Maatschappij Zeetransport N.V., Rotterdam, Holland. Willie was a St. Lawrence canal size vessel engaged in regular trade between Northern European ports and the Great Lakes.
